prompts.name: mineur
prompts.prompt: Edit the provided canonical Dungeon Empire Oculin front artwork into ONE adult Oculin tutorial specialist. Species and rendering lock: same broad head almost merging into shoulders, slate pebbled hide, two short pale rock horns, exactly one enormous organic purple eye, two little upward tusks, wide mouth, stocky legs, broad clawed feet and thick arms. Match original painted chunky sculpted game illustration, controlled dark outlines, broad planes, warm edge light. Distinct adult personality through facial expression and body language. Replace the ceremonial collar with practical specialist clothing, with a small purple cloth nod to the original. No extra eye motifs or eye badges. Orthographic straight front, entire single character, relaxed symmetrical neutral A-pose, empty hands apart from sides, clear gaps, feet aligned. Clean modelable solid geometry, simplify small details for isometric mobile read. Square canvas, ample transparent margin around silhouette, no shadows on ground, no scenery, no typography, no layout panels. Veteran underground miner. Defining silhouette: squat ochre iron mining helmet fitted snugly between his natural horns; a SINGLE broad faceted amber lamp crystal protected by a brass cage is fixed on its crown. Coal-dark sleeveless work vest, angular ochre hide shoulder pad, sturdy belt with a raw amethyst ore chunk secured in a leather loop, dusty knee protectors. Warm copper, soot and ochre. Broad determined grin, one nick in helmet rim. No pickaxe in hands or crossed behind head. The helmet is rugged and medieval fantasy.
